# Integer cubic step-change counterexamples

Eight independently authored, closed cubic paths, generated by
`tools/svg_cubic_step_fixture.py`. All input coordinates are integers. No corpus
artwork or font program is included. The source DOCX preserves the original SVG
and an independently authored, visibly different magenta raster fallback.

`native-api.json` is a hash-bound GDI+ `GraphicsPath.Flatten(null, 0.25)` reference,
captured with `tools/capture-cubic-flatten-sweep.ps1 -QuantizeInput`. This API
reference is not a reference-application rendering reference. The current model matches three
of eight complete contours; no tested fixed precision in 0..22 explains the
other five, even allowing separately selected precisions for x and y under the
same two-dimensional step schedule.

The separate native reference is `capture.emf`, captured from the exact
helper-opened scratch copy using `tools/capture_open_picture_metafile.ps1`.
The document was opened editable; capture operations were read-only and source
hash/Saved state were checked before and after. The capture tool leaves the reference application
and the document open, without changing view settings, selecting, saving,
closing or quitting. `capture.json` labels document and capture state separately.
`tools/record_svg_group_cubic.py` extracts the eight PNG layers and records
source/case/capture/native/image hashes in `metafile-reference.json`.

The current renderer matches all eight native layer sizes and origins and five
complete RGBA layers. Three layers differ at seven alpha pixels total.
Run `node tools/probe-svg-cubic-terminal-rounding.mjs <output.json>
tests/fixtures/svg-cubic-step-changes --current-only` to reproduce the comparison.
The browser regression also verifies no-edit package identity, edit/export/reopen,
unchanged SVG and other package parts, byte-exact undo and temporary-host cleanup.
It intentionally does not require the incorrect pixels to remain incorrect.

The offline substitution of captured control vertices reproduces all eight native
RGBA layers exactly. That diagnostic establishes the source of the seven pixel
differences; no reference-coordinate lookup is shipped in production code.
Compatibility remains unresolved.
